page: Amazon Web Services c7i-flex.16xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with an Intel Xeon 8488C processor operating at 3.2 GHz. The configuration provides 64 virtual CPUs across 32 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. Memory resources consist of 128.0 GB of DDR5 RAM running at 5 GHz, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of memory per core. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong performance in memory bandwidth and specialized compute tasks. The instance achieves a read-only small block memory bandwidth of 4612.53 GB/sec and a large block bandwidth of 200.81 GB/sec, placing it in the top tier of tested hardware. CPU capabilities are highlighted by a Passmark CPU score of 67458.21 and a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression speed of 314.73 GB/sec. The processor supports advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), which accelerate workloads like cryptography and integer manipulation.

This instance is designed for compute-intensive workloads that benefit from high-speed DDR5 memory and dedicated CPU allocation without requiring local NVMe storage. It is highly capable for software compilation, database operations, and static web serving, as demonstrated by its strong Passmark database score of 27201.33 and static web serving throughput of 68.5 GB/sec. Additionally, the AMX instruction set enables efficient CPU-based machine learning tasks, delivering 227.81 tokens/sec for medium-model LLM prompt processing. The flex-class hardware profile offers a cost-efficient alternative for compute-heavy applications that do not require the full resource scaling of standard compute-optimized instances.
